test_environment.session: Electronic trading hours; standard 1m candles; back-adjustment off; chart display UTC-4.

execution.entry_rule: Staged after 09:45 close, earliest next eligible fill 09:46; one entry/day.
execution.exit_rule: 5R target, opposite-range or capped stop, next-available-open EOD close.
execution.same_bar_stop_target: Native Pine emulator priority; TOS parity unresolved.
execution.overlap_rule: One entry per date; two modes share the same 19 entries.

costs.description: $0.95/contract/side, one tick adverse market/stop slippage; limits differ. No second cost deduction from exported net P&L.
